_about: ThunderMax TBW table map for the 2023 Low Rider ST 131 build. Bands are byte-offset ranges in the 214470-byte .tbw, derived by differential analysis of semantically-labeled tune pairs (see table_map.py LABELED_PAIRS). 'confidence' reflects how cleanly a band separated by intent across independent pairs. Engineering-unit scaling and exact axis cell order still require ONE TMax Tuner ground-truth reading per band (see needs_ground_truth). Do not treat medium/low bands as cell-accurate.
record_note: Map cells are little-endian fields on a 4- or 8-byte stride (u16 value, often followed by a flag/limit word), NOT a packed grid. AutoTune correction cells are SIGNED (small negatives appear as 0x0000 -> 0xFFxx borrows in raw diffs).

timing_scale_finding.evidence: global -1 deg edit shifted every cell in the 0xC3C9 timing-linked array by exactly -49 raw; 34deg*49=1666, 33deg*49=1617 (a clean -49 low-byte step with no carry).
timing_scale_finding.caveat: confirmed on the 0xC3C9 scalar/limit array only; the main RPMxTPS timing map's scale is assumed equal but UNCONFIRMED.

bands.name: afr_target
bands.desc: AFR target region (AFR vs TPS/RPM). Isolated by the advancedtiming -> +AFR-correction pair (180 cells changed, no timing/fuel overlap).
bands.needs_ground_truth: Read one AFR target cell in TMax Tuner (e.g. 3000rpm/20% TPS) and match its raw value here to lock scale + cell order.

bands.name: timing_map_main
bands.desc: Primary ignition timing map (deg BTDC vs TPS/RPM). Changed by both the global -1deg and the +2deg-each-point pairs, not by fuel/AFR-only edits.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Confirm 11 RPM rows (1000..6000) x 14 TPS cols (0..100%) ordering against M8_131ci_Timing_Tables doc; verify raw/49 == degrees.

bands.name: afr_ve_pages
bands.desc: Five ~900-byte fuel/VE pages (~0x400 apart), each ~74-76 cells. Rewritten by AFR-target edits and by fuel edits (both AFR-correction and +fuel pairs land here) -> fuel VE pages that AutoTune adjusts to hit the AFR target.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Identify whether these are front/rear fuel-flow (VE) pages by RPM; anchor with one TMax cell per page.

bands.name: fuel_flow_pages
bands.desc: Five ~570-700 byte pages changed by the +fuel edit but not by pure timing or AFR-target edits. Candidate front/rear fuel-flow map pages.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Distinguish front vs rear fuel pages via a rear-only fuel edit; anchor scale with one TMax fuel cell.

bands.name: timing_limit_array
bands.desc: 128 u32 fields (4-byte value on 8-byte stride) forming a timing-linked clamp/limit array. Every cell shifted -49 by the global -1deg edit -> this is where raw_per_degree=49 was measured.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Identify which TMax limit parameter this backs (max-advance / knock-retard clamp).

bands.name: fuel_rich_correction
bands.desc: Large fuel/rich correction + VE-learn region. The 'rich adjustments' edit landed almost entirely here (2081 cells), with AFR overlap. Likely the AutoTune fuel-learn / VE trim store.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Confirm whether this is learned VE (volatile) vs base fuel; treat as AutoTune data until proven otherwise.

bands.name: autotune_learned
bands.desc: Signed AutoTune learned/correction cells (2-byte stride). Churns on every autotune iteration across all edit types; not a directly rider-tuned table.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Likely not user-editable; verify against a 'reset autotune' capture.

bands.name: learned_ve_bulk
bands.desc: Largest single region (~8KB, 4-byte stride). Moves on nearly every change including pure autotune runs. Bulk learned-VE / long-term-trim store or a large checksum-covered block.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Correlate with a known AutoTune clear.

bands.name: section_metadata_checksums
bands.desc: Per-section metadata / checksums below the 0x3C0 boundary. Changes whenever ANY table changes; not tunable content, used only for integrity.
bands.needs_ground_truth: None. Never edit; a bad checksum can brick a flash.

bands.name: shared_churn_unresolved
bands.desc: Broad block that moves on every edit. Interleaves more checksums with structured, map-like page data that is NOT yet separated into named tables. The confirmed afr_target and timing_map_main bands are nested inside this range and take precedence. Anything else labeled SHARED here is unresolved -- do not interpret its values.
bands.needs_ground_truth: Needs surgically-isolated single-table edits (change ONE map in TMax, save, diff) to split the real pages out of the checksum churn.
